rules.title: Minimum Thread Size
rules.description: Tapping M2 or smaller is not recommended, but the file can be created. We recommend a minimum tapping of M3.
rules.rule: Thread size must be larger than M2 (M3, M4, M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, etc.). Extract numeric value from thread size string and validate > 2.0
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** Tapping < M2 is not recommended, but the file can be created. We recommend a minimum tapping of M3. Do you want to continue with M2 or another tapping?

rules.title: Minimum Distance from Threading Hole Edge to Part Edge
rules.description: The drilled hole for threading must be positioned so that its edge (not center) is at least 1x thickness distance from the nearest material edge for structural integrity.
rules.rule:
The distance from the drill hole EDGE to the nearest part edge must be >= 1 x material thickness. IMPORTANT: The user gives threading position as center coordinates — you MUST compute from the drill hole edge, not the center. Use the drill diameter from the Standard ISO table (TH_06) or Fine ISO table (TH_07) to get the drill radius.
CALCULATION METHOD:
1. Determine threading center position (cx, cy) on the part. If position is given as distance from corner (e.g. '4mm du coin'), interpret as cx = distance, cy = distance from the two nearest edges.
2. Look up the drill_diameter for the requested thread size from TH_06 (Standard ISO) or TH_07 (Fine ISO). Use Standard ISO by default.
   - Example: M3 → drill_diameter = 2.5mm (Standard ISO)
3. Compute drill_radius = drill_diameter / 2
4. Compute the distance from the drill hole EDGE to each part edge:
   - Distance to left edge   = cx - drill_radius
   - Distance to right edge  = length - cx - drill_radius
   - Distance to bottom edge = cy - drill_radius
   - Distance to top edge    = width - cy - drill_radius
5. Find minimum hole-edge-to-part-edge distance = min of the four values above
6. Compare against threshold: 1 × material thickness
7. If min_distance < threshold → VIOLATION
EXAMPLE: Sheet 100×100mm, thickness 4mm, M3 threading at 4mm from corner → cx=4, cy=4.
   drill_diameter (M3, Standard ISO) = 2.5mm → drill_radius = 1.25mm
   Distance to left edge = 4 - 1.25 = 2.75mm. Threshold = 1 × 4 = 4mm. 2.75 < 4 → VIOLATION.
EXAMPLE OK: Sheet 100×100mm, thickness 4mm, M3 threading at cx=10, cy=10.
   Distance to left edge = 10 - 1.25 = 8.75mm. Threshold = 4mm. 8.75 >= 4 → OK.
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend a minimum tapping-edge distance ≥ 1 x thickness. Do you want to continue or modify?

rules.title: Blind Threaded/Tapping Hole Depth and Position Requirements
rules.description: For blind threaded holes (blind tapping), specific information about depth and position must be clarified.
rules.rule: When blind thread is mentioned, ask for hole depth. When position is not specified, ask for face location.
rules.error_message: What is the depth of the threading? On which face of the plate is this blind threading located?

rules.title: Thickness for threading
rules.rule: Answer if user_request wants to know list of thicknesses for threading (TOLERY) or raise error if violation
rules.error_message:
Threading constraints by thickness: Only add for thicknesses >= 1.5mm
- 1.5mm: M3-M5
- 2-3mm: M3-M10
- 4-12mm: Steel and Aluminium: M3-M16, Stainless Steel: M4-M16
- 15-25mm: M3-M24

rules.rule: If the customer wants to know the manufacturing guidelines for threading at TOLERY (or similar questions)
rules.error_message: Please consult the detailed information regarding manufacturing guidelines for threading on our website at the following link https://www.tolery.io/expertise/usinage !

rules.title: Threading Specifications Reference Table (STANDARD ISO)
description: Nominal Diameter | Pitch (mm) | Drilling Diameter Before Threading (mm)

rules.title: Threading Specifications Reference Table (FINE ISO)
description: Nominal Diameter | Pitch (mm) | Drilling Diameter Before Threading (mm)

rules.title: Nominal Diameter Outside Metric Thread Data Table
rules.description: Check if the requested nominal diameter exists in the metric thread data tables (TH_06 or TH_07). If not found, warn the user.
rules.rule: Validate that the nominal diameter exists in either the STANDARD ISO (TH_06) or FINE ISO (TH_07) reference tables. If not found, trigger warning.
rules.error_message: Warning! This type of threading is outside the metric thread data table. Do you want to continue or see the metric thread data?

rules.title: Pitch Does Not Match ISO Standard
rules.description: Check if the combination of nominal diameter and pitch matches the standard ISO (TH_06) or fine ISO (TH_07) threading data. If the values don't correspond, warn the user.
rules.rule: Validate that the pitch value matches the nominal diameter according to either STANDARD ISO (TH_06) or FINE ISO (TH_07) reference tables. If the combination is not found in either table, trigger warning.
rules.error_message: Warning! The entered data does not correspond to standard or fine ISO pitch threading data. Do you want to continue or see this data?
